text:
Alex: Kicking off 'TestPilot' pilot cohort planning. Need recruitment targets, feedback cadence, and exit criteria. Quick sync?
Maria: Short list of constraints I care about: 1) representative customers (SaaS + AI-native), 2) clear success metrics, 3) narrow scope. Proposed cohort = 12 orgs, 3 months. Thoughts? :seedling:
Lin: 12 sounds doable. Question: will any pilots require Private/VPC installs or is this hosted-only? Infra impacts timelines.
Maria: Mix — aim for 8 hosted, 4 private (VPC). We'll mark private as higher touch and later start date.
Sam: From CS/sales: target accounts should have >10k tokens/day or require predictable latency. We'll prioritize 4 existing customers who asked for low-latency fallbacks.
Elena: @Lin FYI ops: reserving Dedicated capacity for hosted pilots needs a 2-week lead. For VPC, we need customer NAT / peering checklist.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: Capacity booking required. Please add ticket: INFRA-TESTPILOT-001 with desired dates. :gear:
Alex: Success metrics proposal: - Engagement: 60% of invited power users > weekly active - Quality: no >10% regression in eval prompts - Performance: p95 latency < 250ms for conversational flows - Econ: avg token cost < target by 20% vs baseline
Maria: Add adoption metric: at least 3 product hooks (search, summarization, chat) exercised across cohort. Also want qualitative feedback 1:1 each month.
Lin: We need instrumentation hooks in the SDK to tag pilot traffic (pilot_id, org_id, feature_flags). Also add a quick /events endpoint to collect session-level feedback. Small code sample for tagging:```python
client = Redwood(api_key=KEY, tags={"pilot":"testpilot-2024", "cohort":"A"})
resp = client.generate("...")
```
Sam: Recruitment plan: top-30 prospects (CS+AM nominate), outreach template, 1:1 kickoff sessions, and an incentivized feedback stipend (gift credit or bill credit).
Maria: Scope negotiation: initial API surface = chat + embeddings only. Delay advanced tool-calling or structured outputs until after month 1 if stable.
Alex: Launch gates (must pass before we go live with a customer): 1) infra capacity ticket closed, 2) pilot_tagging pushed, 3) onboarding doc + security checklist signed, 4) two internal smoke customers green.
Elena: Security checklist note: For VPC we require SOC2 checklist + customer KMS proof. That may add 7 business days.
Lin: Tech risk: KV cache warmup for long prompts — we should add a monitoring alert for cache-miss rate > 30% and token regen errors.
Maria: Feedback cadence: weekly short async survey (2 mins) + monthly 30m interview. We'll collect NPS + 3 targeted prompts for regression detection.
Alex: Exit criteria (what makes a pilot successful): 1) meets engagement and performance targets, 2) no severe reliability incidents, 3) product adoption signal (>=2 product hooks used by >25% orgs), 4) customer willing to commit to pilot report meeting.
Sam: If pilot fails, fallback plan: offer reduced scope or convert to sandbox + bill credit. Need to define SLA rollback steps.
Maria: Action items: - Alex: finalize invite template + success metric doc by Fri - Maria: compile initial cohort shortlist (12) by Tue - Lin: implement pilot tagging + cache alert by Wed - Elena: open infra capacity ticket INFRA-TESTPILOT-001 now - Sam: assemble outreach pack and incentive options by Thu
Alex: Great. If no objections I'll spin up a shared doc with timeline and the gating checklist after this thread. :white_check_mark:
Lin: No objections. Adding a quick perf-run this afternoon against a synthetic workload.
Sam: I'll DM folks for prospect nominations.
Maria: Thanks all — small, high-signal cohort > big noisy one.
OpsBot: reminder-bot: Weekly pilot sync scheduled Fridays 10:00am PT.
